title: diini girah gibbatu
intro: dumaahi baaxol xaahi diini kulli buxal ramid beeh suge, inki num baxsa luk sooleh suge. Inkih tan giclo kee diini kalalu, fooca fanah fooca fanah gexaanam faxximta — kee giclo sinnim gexen. Atu tama assakat le roocih mamaxxaga baxxaqissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu sinni gabat bicsen sanamitteh qununeh yan marih fanat yenbeeh, tama duyye yallih caylat taniimil yaamineenih.
Anu ken mablah bood abe way, oson qimbol yoo diiriyeenih, takkay immay anu aaxigeh an nummat tibba axcem maduuda.
oson iroh gaaboowe ayro, anu ken sanamitte finqiseh, dubuk kaxxa tiya xaggiime kal cabe.
Oson uduurra heenih, anu abeh an taama yubleenih, ken miraaciini kaxxa laqna xisaanam amrisen, laqna yoo qidoonuh niyat luk sugeenim.
oson girah addat yoo qideenih, takkay immay baad degelti xamca yoh amaanah akah yallennah amrise.
Anu girah addak inki gabuuk biyaakite kal ewqeh, too yoo saduh bicsen mari foocal finqite.

verse: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act." (21:68)
